NoteNlpAccessor::mask_urls¶

Back to Note NLP Accessor API Reference

Signature¶

Note NoteNlpAccessor::mask_urls() const

Remove Destinations While Preserving Sentence Punctuation¶

mask_urls() replaces HTTP, HTTPS, and www. URL-shaped spans with [URL]. Scheme matching is case-insensitive. Paths, fragments, and query strings remain part of the same match, so a complete destination becomes one placeholder rather than several numeric or punctuation fragments.

The recognized starts are http://, https://, and www.. Bare domains and other schemes such as ftp:// are intentionally outside this method. A URL must end in a URL-like byte; terminal prose punctuation such as ., ,, !, closing ), ], or a quote remains in the sentence. Characters such as ?, #, &, =, /, _, %, ~, +, and - may legitimately end a URL.

This is deterministic text masking, not network validation. The method does not resolve hosts or check whether a resource exists. Use remove_urls when the span and its category marker should both disappear.

The receiver must be Text. The result is a fresh packed Text Note with the same shape, and the receiver is unchanged. Undefined propagates, empty shapes stay defined and empty, and [URL] is idempotent. Cells without an HTTP or www. prefix take a fast no-match path.

Example 1: Scheme, Case, Path, Query, And Fragment¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::note::make({"HTTPS://example.com/a?q=1", "www.x.io/path#part"})
        .nlp().mask_urls()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[2], dim=1, numel=2, encoding=utf8)
["[URL]", "[URL]"]

Example 2: Sentence Punctuation And Unsupported Schemes¶

std::cout << pluss::note::print(
    pluss::note::make({"(https://x.io/a), www.x.io! not ftp://x.io"})
        .nlp().mask_urls()) << '\n';

Output¶

Note(shape=[1], dim=1, numel=1, encoding=utf8)
["([URL]), [URL]! not ftp://x.io"]

Example 3: Empty, Undefined, And Bytes¶

const auto empty = pluss::note::make(std::vector<std::string>{})
                       .nlp().mask_urls();
std::cout << "urls empty dim=" << empty.dim()
          << " numel=" << empty.numel() << '\n';
std::cout << "urls undefined=" << std::boolalpha
          << pluss::Note::undefined().nlp().mask_urls().defined() << '\n';
try {
  (void)pluss::note::bytes(
      std::vector<std::string>{"https://x.io"},
      std::array<std::int64_t, 1>{1}).nlp().mask_urls();
} catch (const pluss::Error&) { std::cout << "urls Bytes: rejected\n"; }

Output¶

urls empty dim=1 numel=0
urls undefined=false
urls Bytes: rejected

See Also¶

  • remove_urls: delete recognized URLs instead of preserving [URL].

  • mask_pii: mask URLs before mentions and broad numbers.
